notes: 🎥 Test your vertical from a video: mark takeoff and landing, and the app works out your jump height from your air time.
📈 Dunk countdown: how many weeks until you dunk your goal at your current pace, plus your touch height from your standing reach.
🏋️ Strength levels: see where your squat, bench, deadlift, press and row rank for your bodyweight.
▥ Scan barcodes for instant nutrition facts, “Hit your protein” suggestions built from your foods, and Copy from yesterday.
🎙️ “Hey Siri, log my weight”: set it up in Settings → Alerts.
